activity_payload.meaning: Listen like a winnowing basket and sift useful words from noise.
activity_payload.belief: I keep the words that help me grow.
activity_payload.title: Keep or Let Go Sort
activity_payload.hook: Can you listen like Ganesha and sort the words that help you grow?
steps: Read each word or sentence one at a time.
Put helpful growth words into KEEP and noisy hurtful words into LET GO.
Choose one KEEP card to say out loud at the end.
activity_payload.reflection: Which helpful words do you want your ears to remember today?
activity_payload.affirmation: I keep the words that help me grow.
activity_payload.real_life_transfer: Later today, pause and keep the sentence that truly helps.
